---
name: first-issue-pack
description: Create implementation-ready starter issues for VenturaVoice from the approved audio MVP and Beta gates. Use when maintainers need small independent tasks that move the scaffold toward a reproducible prototype. Do not use when requirements are undefined or the issue would duplicate active work.
---

# First issue pack

- Read the current MVP scope and repository state first.
- Create one verifiable outcome per issue.
- Include consent licensing or privacy acceptance criteria when sample audio is involved.
- Separate core implementation tests documentation and demo work when independent.
- Keep each issue suitable for one focused pull request.
- Mark dependencies explicitly and avoid speculative model integrations.
